cohort: Pregnant women with singleton pregnancies less than 22 weeks' gestation were recruited, with 234 participants included in the final analysis after excluding those with previous preterm delivery, pre-existing medical conditions, obstetric complications, or later development of systemic infection.
finding: High maternal serum CRP levels in early pregnancy (specifically > 6 mg/L) were not significantly associated with spontaneous preterm delivery in this cohort (p = 0.087).
gest_age: Pregnancies less than 22 weeks' gestation at enrollment; outcome defined as preterm delivery.
